title: Redesign Admin Dashboard layout, fix Barcode field, and fix Add Product button hang

requirements.text: Redesign the Admin Dashboard page (AdminPage.tsx) layout to professional standards: use a clean two-column or sidebar-main layout with clear visual hierarchy, consistent spacing, section headings, and card-based panels for each tab's content area.

quotes: Redesign the Admin Dashboard layout as per professional standards

acceptanceCriteria: Admin Dashboard uses a professional layout with consistent spacing, clear headings, and card-based panels
Tab content areas are visually separated with proper padding and alignment
Layout is responsive and does not overflow on common screen sizes

requirements.text: Redesign the 'Add New Product' section in AdminProductForm.tsx as a clean, well-aligned card: use a single cohesive card container with proper label/input alignment (grid or flex layout), consistent input sizing, grouped sections (e.g., basic info, pricing, media), and clear visual separation between fields.

quotes: The 'Add New Product' section should be a clean card with better alignment

acceptanceCriteria: 'Add New Product' section is rendered inside a styled card component with clear header
All form fields are consistently aligned using a grid or flex layout
Related fields are visually grouped (e.g., name/category together, price/unit together)
The card has appropriate padding, border, and shadow consistent with the dashboard design

requirements.text: Fix the Barcode field in AdminProductForm.tsx to be fully functional: the barcode input must accept manual text entry, and the camera-based BarcodeScanner integration must correctly populate the barcode field value when a code is scanned. Ensure the scanned value is bound to the form state.

quotes: Ensure that the 'Barcode' field is functional

acceptanceCriteria: Barcode text input accepts manual keyboard entry and updates form state correctly
Triggering the BarcodeScanner and scanning a barcode populates the barcode field with the scanned value
The barcode value is included in the product data submitted to the backend

requirements.text: Fix the 'Add Product' button in AdminProductForm.tsx so it does not get stuck in the 'Adding Product...' loading state. Ensure the mutation's loading/pending state is properly reset on both success and error, the button returns to its default state after the operation completes, and success/error feedback is shown to the user.

quotes: the 'Add Product' button doesn't hang on 'Adding Product...'

acceptanceCriteria: After a successful product addition, the button returns to its default 'Add Product' label and is re-enabled
After a failed product addition, the button returns to its default state and an error message is displayed
The button is disabled only while the mutation is actively in-flight
Form resets or shows a success notification after successful submission

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
Backend API contracts (product schema, mutation signatures) must not be changed
Existing product management functionality (image upload, category selection, unit type) must remain intact
nonGoals: Redesigning pages other than the Admin Dashboard and its sub-components
Adding new product fields beyond what already exists
Modifying the BillingPage or BillTemplate components
